training_supervision.type: single qualified LLM teacher distillation; not human gold and not response uplift

interpretation.what_is_now_true: The MS selector can discriminate atomic candidate suitability across connected user groups and a frozen full-fit checkpoint exists.
interpretation.what_is_not_yet_true: The end-to-end PM has not yet shown that selected memories are naturally absorbed into better replies or that RS+MS beats same-stack baselines.
interpretation.semantic_scope: The observed signal is bounded candidate usefulness—specificity, nonredundancy, age/pool context and semantic retrieval geometry—not unrestricted human-level language understanding.

executor_qualification_requirements: Use the component-general V3 response program, never V2 literal-splice code.
Generate same-state MS-ON and MS-OFF arms with the same generator, seed policy, schema and current context.
Exact source is provenance/interpretation input; no literal mention or lexical-overlap requirement.
Safe non-use keeps the current-context reply and downgrades realized MS OFF; it never triggers the old generic fallback.
Only owner/time/scaffold contamination permits one personal-resource-free retry.
Offline source-aware function, literal risk events, quality and cost remain separate; generator telemetry is not function gold.
Qualification must contain both teacher-suitable and teacher-not-suitable atomic cases and must not impose a one-memory cap or change the 16-action design.
